Magic: The Gathering Comprehensive Rules

These rules are effective as of February 27, 2026.

Introduction

This document is the ultimate authority for Magic gameplay.

1. Game Concepts

100. General

100.1. These Magic rules apply to any Magic game with two or more players, including two-player games and multiplayer games.

100.1a A two-player game is a game that begins with only two players.

100.2. To play, each player needs their own deck of traditional Magic cards.

100.10. This is a sibling rule, not a subrule of 100.1, and must not be returned when expanding 100.1.

7. Additional Rules

702. Keyword Abilities

702.19. Trample

702.19a Trample is a static ability that modifies the rules for combat damage assignment.

Glossary

Trample
A keyword ability that modifies how combat damage is assigned. See rule 702.19, "Trample."

Commander
A legendary creature designated as the deck's commander. See rule 903, "Commander."
